# Commands Electron desktop shell, branding, and build-capable worktrees

Electron `session.fromPartition("persist:name")` provides persistent app-owned sessions; `WebContentsView` is preferred to legacy `<webview>`. Electron-managed pages, Commands’ Playwright browser, and Codex browser tools remain separate integrations until an explicit MCP/dynamic-tool bridge is implemented and tested. [Task 1]

Scope: console.
